footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Finance of America Companies: after $6.5M of discontinued operations, $57.8M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 26.1% to $497M in 2025. Operating income rose 2.6× to $113M, a 22.7% margin.
Net income rose 2.9× to $45.2M, or $3.74 per share. Operating cash flow was −$430M and free cash flow −$430M, versus −$424M.
